changes.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity adds private certificate authority support
changes.detail: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports private certificate authorities (CAs) for custom OAuth 2.0 credential providers. If you already connect your agents to identity providers (IdPs) hosted in your VPC, you can now configure those connections to trust certificates issued by your own CA — including AWS Private CA, enterprise CAs, and self-signed root CAs. AgentCore Identity has supported private IdP connectivity through Amazon VPC Lattice, but until now the IdP still had to present a publicly trusted TLS certificate over that private connection.
